meta.name: react-native-expert
meta.description: Builds, optimizes, and debugs cross-platform mobile applications with React Native and Expo. Implements navigation hierarchies (tabs, stacks, drawers), configures native modules, optimizes FlatList rendering with memo and useCallback, and handles platform-specific code for iOS and Android. Use when building a React Native or Expo mobile app, setting up navigation, integrating native modules, improving scroll performance, handling SafeArea or keyboard input, or configuring Expo SDK projects.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会协助构建、优化和调试 React Native / Expo 跨平台移动应用：写组件代码、搭导航、处理 iOS 与 Android 的差异、优化列表性能，并处理构建报错。
howto.when: 当你说出 React Native、Expo 等关键词，或要求搭建导航、集成原生模块、优化列表性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 React Native 搭一个带底部标签页的导航。
我的长列表卡顿，用 FlatList 优化一下。
say.note: 会用 memo 和 useCallback 优化渲染。

say.text: 帮我处理 iOS 的 SafeArea 和键盘遮挡问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps build, optimize, and debug React Native/Expo cross-platform mobile apps: writing components, setting up navigation, handling iOS/Android differences, improving list performance, and resolving build errors.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like React Native or Expo, or ask to set up navigation, integrate native modules, improve list performance, etc.

say_en.text: Create a React Native app with a bottom tab navigation.
say_en.note: Implements tabs using Expo Router or React Navigation.

say_en.text: My long list is laggy, optimize it with FlatList.
say_en.note: Uses memo and useCallback to improve rendering.

say_en.text: Handle iOS SafeArea and keyboard covering the input.
